notes: The certificate's requirements table starts on catalog page 132 (PDF page 133) and continues on page 133 (PDF page 134) under a running header for the Building Commissioning Technician certificate; the continuation rows (ACR 065 through ACR 092) and 'CERTIFICATE TOTAL 21' were read as belonging to Building Automation Control.
Catalog codes use leading zeros (ACR 060, ACR 090) and were matched to closed-list codes ACR 60, ACR 64, ACR 65, ACR 76, ACR 91, ACR090 and ACR092.

Title differences to check: the catalog calls ACR 090 'Introduction to Building Automation Systems' (closed list: 'Building Automation Fundamentals'); the catalog calls ACR 091 'Introduction to Building Automation Networks and Programming' (closed list: 'Advanced Building Control Networks').
The BESP AS degree's Building Automation Control specialty (page 131) also lists ACR 084, but that is the degree section, not this certificate, so it was not recorded.

Careers were taken from the certificate description: 'skills needed by entry level technicians in the commercial ... HVAC industry' and 'a path to various commercial Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) career areas'.
